item.title: Is Dental Tourism in Albania Safe?
item.author: Dr. Shukri Jahiu
item.description:
One of the most important questions for patients considering coming to Albania for dental treatment is: Is Albania safe?

For many years, a part of Europeans has seen Albania as a problematic country. But this perception often belongs to the past and does not reflect the reality of today's Albania.

Today, Albania is a European destination that welcomes tourists from Italy, Switzerland, Germany, Austria, and other countries. International recognition keeps growing too. Lonely Planet included Albania among the world's top-30 destinations for Best in Travel 2023. The New York Times placed the Albanian Alps in its "52 Places to Go" for 2024, and in 2025 it described how Albania seized its moment in the sun as one of Europe's newest destinations. UN Tourism ranks Albania third globally for tourist arrival growth (+80% since 2019), and in 2026 the country continues as the Mediterranean's fastest-growing destination. Tirana has also become an important destination for dental tourism.

How Safe Is Albania?

Safety should be assessed on the basis of facts and not just perceptions.

In the Global Peace Index 2026, Albania ranks 36th out of 163 countries, placing it among the most peaceful countries in the world, ahead of countries such as the United Kingdom and France. According to the Numbeo Safety Index, Tirana scores higher than major European cities like London and Paris. For travellers, mainly normal safety precautions are recommended, as in many other European destinations.

Of course, ordinary crime also exists in Albania, but this does not mean that tourists or international patients should consider the country an unsafe destination.

What About Patients Coming for Dental Treatment?

Yes, Albania can be a safe destination for dental tourism.

But patient safety is not only about the country. It is very important to choose a serious and professional clinic.

The patient should check the experience and qualifications of the doctors, the equipment, hygiene, sterilization, the treatment plan, the materials used, the costs, and the aftercare.

Albania and Dental Tourism

Proximity to European countries, air connections, and competitive costs have made Albania increasingly interesting for international patients. Learn more about dental tourism in Albania and how dental tourism works.

Patients from Switzerland, Italy, Germany, and Austria travel to Tirana for treatments such as dental implants, crowns, All-on-4, All-on-6, and full dental rehabilitations.

For a patient from Switzerland, for example, Albania is relatively close and can be an interesting alternative for dental treatment, but the choice should always be made on the basis of quality and professionalism, not only price.

What Do Our Patients Say?

Patients from different European countries have already travelled to Tirana for their treatment. Here is what our patients say about their experience:

Francesco Gentile – Italy Francesco describes a treatment that included extractions, dental implants, removal of a cyst, and bone reconstruction. In his review, he highlights the professionalism, hygiene, and equipment of the clinic.

Assunta Tedino – Italy Assunta came to Tirana for a dental implant and, in her review, she highlights the cleanliness, professionalism, and care during the treatment.

Roberto Ferrara – Italy Roberto tells that he had 3 implants and 3 crowns done and describes the experience as very positive. He also says that he has recommended the clinic to friends and family.

Mirtane Aliu – Austria Mirtane talks about her experience after travelling from Austria to Albania and appreciates the dental treatment and the organization of her stay.

These are personal experiences of patients and do not replace an individual medical assessment. Nevertheless, they show that patients from different European countries travel to Albania for dental treatment. You can see more patient stories with before-and-after results.

What Should You Check Before Choosing a Clinic?

Before travelling, look for clear information about the doctor, the diagnosis, the treatment plan, the materials, the technology, the costs, and the aftercare.

Price should not be the only criterion. A dental treatment, especially implants or full rehabilitations, requires planning and professionalism. It is equally important to check the experience and qualifications of the surgeon who will treat you.

Albania Today

Today's Albania is very different from the image that may have remained from the past.

So, if you are thinking of coming to Albania for dental treatment, do not base your decision only on old perceptions. Inform yourself, check the clinic, the doctors, the treatment, and the experiences of patients.

Dental tourism in Albania can be a safe and practical choice for patients from Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Austria, and other European countries, when a serious clinic and a professional organization of the treatment are chosen. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.

item.title: Dentists in Albania and the Growth of Dental Tourism
item.author: Dr. Shukri Jahiu
item.description:
With the growth of dental tourism in Albania, the opening and development of dental clinics has also gained significant momentum in recent years. This sector has brought many investments and new opportunities, but there are also some aspects patients should be careful about.

On the positive side, many dental clinics in Albania have made substantial investments in modern facilities, advanced technology, and state-of-the-art equipment. These investments have helped raise the quality of services and support the further development of dental tourism. DentalHealth is also part of this development and has invested in technology, facilities, and modern standards to offer patients the most professional service possible.

However, there is also an issue that should not be overlooked. In the dental tourism market, there are cases where clinics are created primarily as business investments by people who are not professionals in the field of dentistry. In these cases, the owner may be only an investor, while the medical service is entrusted to dentists with varying levels of experience.

This does not mean that a clinic founded by an investor is necessarily unprofessional. But patients should be well informed before choosing a clinic.

It is very important to look at the clinic's track record, the experience of the doctors, their professional training, the cases they have treated, the technology they use, and the way treatment is organized.

In the end, marketing can present a clinic very beautifully, but what matters most is professionalism, experience, and the treatment outcome.

Therefore, our advice to every patient considering dental treatment in Albania is: do not base your decision only on price or marketing. Inform yourself about the clinic, the doctor who will treat you, and the experience they have in the relevant field.

Dental tourism in Albania has enormous potential and, if developed on the basis of professionalism, transparency, and quality of treatment, it can become one of the most important medical service sectors in the country. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.

item.title: Dental Implants in Albania: The Implant Brands We Use
item.author: Dr. Shukri Jahiu
item.description:
With the growth of dental tourism in Albania, the dental implant market has also developed at a fast pace. Today, implants of different categories can be found in Albania, from premium brands to more affordable alternatives.

At our clinic, Dental Health, we use different implant brands, choosing the implant system based on the clinical needs of the patient, quality, and budget.

1. Straumann

Straumann is one of the most well-known and highly regarded brands in implantology, positioned in the premium segment and known for its quality, scientific research, and advanced technology.

2. Hiossen

Hiossen is a brand widely used in our practice, offering a good combination of quality, technology, and price, which makes it a suitable choice for many patients.

3. Medigma

Medigma is an alternative with a good price-quality ratio, which can be used in suitable clinical cases and offers a more economical solution for patients.

4. Alpha Bio

Alpha Bio is a well-known brand in implantology that offers implant systems focused on practicality, reliability, and a good ratio between quality and cost.

At Dental Health, our goal is not simply to offer different implants, but to choose the most suitable system for each patient, taking into consideration the clinical condition, the treatment plan, and the expectations of the patient.

item.title: Full-Mouth Implant Rehabilitation After All-on-4 Failure Due to Peri-Implantitis
item.author: Dr. Shukri Jahiu
item.description:
The patient presented to our clinic with an All-on-4 rehabilitation of the upper arch compromised by advanced peri-implantitis, characterized by significant peri-implant bone loss and a hopeless prognosis for the existing implants. The lower arch had two implants affected by chronic infection with bone loss, making their retention impossible.

Phase I – Diagnosis and Planning

Clinical examination, CBCT analysis, and digital treatment planning were performed. After evaluation, it was decided to remove all implants with a hopeless prognosis and proceed with full-mouth rehabilitation using a new implant plan.

Phase II – Surgical Treatment

  • Removal of the existing All-on-4 prosthesis
  • Explantation of the four upper arch implants affected by peri-implantitis
  • Explantation of the two infected implants in the lower arch
  • Complete debridement of inflammatory tissue and cleaning of surgical sites
  • Alveolar preparation and implant surgery according to the prosthetic plan

Phase III – Implant Placement

After establishing a healthy bone base, new implants were placed in strategic positions for full rehabilitation of both arches. Primary implant stability was assessed as adequate for treatment continuation.

Phase IV – Prosthetic Rehabilitation

After the osseointegration period, definitive impressions were taken and the fixed restoration on implants was completed. Vertical dimension, occlusion, phonetics, and aesthetics were carefully verified, ensuring optimal distribution of functional loads.

Result

The final rehabilitation restored:

  • Masticatory function
  • Natural smile aesthetics
  • Occlusal stability
  • Peri-implant tissue health
  • Comfort and quality of life

Conclusion

This case demonstrates that even in the presence of advanced implant failure due to peri-implantitis, careful planning and surgical-prosthetic treatment performed according to modern protocols can successfully restore oral function and aesthetics.

Treatment performed by Dr. Shukri Jahiu at Dental Health Clinic – Tirana, Albania.

item.title: Dental Implants: What They Are, Benefits, and Who Can Get Them
item.author: Dr. Shukri Jahiu
item.description:
What is a dental implant?

A dental implant is a biocompatible titanium structure designed to replace the root of a missing tooth. Once placed into the jawbone, it serves as a stable foundation for a crown, bridge, or fixed prosthesis, restoring both function and aesthetics to your smile.

Why replace missing teeth?

Losing one or more teeth is not only an aesthetic issue but a functional one as well. Missing teeth make chewing difficult, which negatively affects the digestive process. Additionally, it can cause shifting of adjacent teeth, jawbone loss, bite problems, and speech difficulties. For this reason, replacing missing teeth is essential for maintaining oral health and overall well-being.

What are the advantages of dental implants?

Dental implants offer:

  • Natural aesthetics — a harmonious and natural-looking smile
  • Full functionality — complete chewing ability and clear speech
  • Bone preservation — maintains jawbone and facial structure
  • Stability and longevity — a durable, long-lasting solution
  • Confidence — increased self-esteem and quality of life

Who is a candidate for dental implants?

Almost any patient who has lost one or more teeth and is in good general health can be a candidate. Even patients with significant bone loss can be treated thanks to modern techniques such as zygomatic and pterygoid implants, which avoid the need for extensive bone grafting in many cases.

In cases of complete tooth loss, the most commonly used solutions are All-on-4 and All-on-6 concepts, which enable full-arch rehabilitation with a limited number of implants, providing a durable, functional, and aesthetic smile.

item.title: How Dental Surgery Is Performed at Dental Health
item.author: Dr. Shukri Jahiu
item.description:
The first and most important step of any surgical procedure is the consultation with the patient. Unfortunately, this is a phase that many dental clinics neglect, while for us it is the top priority.

During the consultation, it is essential to listen carefully to the patient's history and conduct a detailed anamnesis. At this stage, we gather all information regarding the patient's health status, systemic diseases, medications being taken, allergies, previous procedures, and any other factors that may affect the surgical treatment. A thorough anamnesis allows us to plan each intervention safely and in a personalized way for every patient.

After completing the anamnesis, we proceed with radiological examination. At Dental Health, we use CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) technology, which enables a three-dimensional analysis of anatomical structures and highly accurate surgical planning.

The majority of our patients come from Italy, and the procedures we perform most frequently include full-mouth rehabilitations with All-on-4 and All-on-6, sinus lift, dental implants, as well as pterygoid and zygomatic implants, which are used in more complex cases of bone deficiency.

A key element that sets Dental Health apart is that no surgical procedure is ever performed without the presence of an anesthesiologist-reanimator. All procedures are carried out under conscious sedation, which not only ensures the patient's comfort and calmness during the operation but also guarantees maximum safety in the event of any potential complications. Every patient is continuously monitored by the anesthesiologist throughout the entire procedure.

Once the patient is prepared, the surgical procedure is performed by Dr. Shukri Jahiu, an oral surgeon with over 20 years of experience in the field of dentistry and implantology.

Within 24 hours of the surgery, temporary teeth are fabricated and placed, allowing the patient to restore both function and aesthetics in a very short time. This is a service that Dental Health provides entirely in-house, thanks to the on-site dental laboratory. This enables direct communication between the surgeon and the dental technician, better quality control, and significantly faster turnaround time for prosthetic work.
